text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ugh... My back stings every time I move like this, it's driving me crazy!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you,
I can't even scrub my back in peace in the bath...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Haaah, seriously.
When it rains, it really pours, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Inari One was troubled by her rough skin.
